opportunities.source_name: OpenGov — County of San Mateo, CA
opportunities.title: Facility Condition Assessment and Asset Management Solution
opportunities.description: The County of San Mateo (County) is soliciting competitive proposals from qualified firms to deliver a turnkey Facility Condition Assessment (FCA), compile a unified Master Equipment Register (MER), deploy an enterprise-grade cloud Facility Condition Information System (FCIS), and implement bi-directional integration with the County’s Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) IBM Maximo Application Suite SaaS. This solicitation is structured into two distinct operational phases: PHASE 1 (BASE SCOPE) : Complete on-site baseline Facility Condition Assessments across approximately 100 facilities (~4.5 million gross square feet across 75 sites) following ASTM E2018-24 standards. Perform discrete equipment nameplate inventories and install durable 2D physical barcode tags for maintainable mechanical, electrical, plumbing, conveyance, and life-safety systems. Compile and validate a unified Master Equipment Register (MER) that establishes an identical data baseline between IBM Maximo and the FCIS. Provide, configure, and host a SaaS-based FCIS platform delivering real-time Facility Condition Index (FCI) calculations, multi-year capital renewal modeling, and localized RSMeans-based cost estimating. Format, validate, and batch-load the complete Master Equipment Register directly into the County’s IBM Maximo Application Suite environment, and establish automated synchronization between Maximo and the FCIS. PHASE 2 (OPTIONAL/ADD-ALTERNATIVE SCOPE): Develop standard, manufacturer-aligned Preventive Maintenance (PM) Job Plans, task check-sheets, and recommended service frequencies, pre-formatted for direct batch upload into Maximo Job Plans and PM Master applications.

opportunities.title: Office Furniture
opportunities.description: The Department of Information Technology is undertaking a facilities improvement project to enhance the functionality, comfort, and efficiency of its working environment. This project includes upgrading interior finishes—such as replacing worn carpeting—to create a modern, professional workspace that aligns with current departmental standards. In addition, existing work areas will be reconfigured and enhanced to better support current staffing levels and operational needs. A key component of this project is the modernization of employee workstations. Existing furniture systems will be replaced or modified to meet contemporary ergonomic standards, including the incorporation of sit‑stand functionality to promote employee wellness and productivity. These upgrades will ensure that the workspace supports both current and future operational requirements, improves overall user experience, and aligns with best practices for modern office environments. Please provide a cost proposal to furnish and install the following HON furniture items: (see attachment for detailed specification) Four (4) workstations, 5′-6″ × 6′-0″, with 49″-high panels and 15″-high frameless frosted glass at the locations shown on the plan. Three (3) workstations, 6′-6″ × 6′-0″, with 49″-high panels and 15″-high frameless frosted glass at the locations shown on the plan. One (1) L-shaped sit-stand desk, 72″ W × 78″ D, with all components shown in the furniture schedule. One (1) conference table, 72″ W × 36″ D. Fifteen (15) Herman Miller Aeron task chairs, Size B, black, or City-approved equal in accordance with Section 2.19. Include all applicable furniture, delivery, installation, and tax in the proposal. Carpet replacement will be performed separately and coordinated with furniture removal and installation.

opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena (“City”) is seeking proposals from qualified firms to provide a comprehensive Advanced Metering Infrastructure (“AMI”) solution, together with associated installation services, for the City’s water and electric utilities. The objective of this RFP is to select a vendor capable of providing a vendor-hosted AMI headend system with a supporting communications network, as well as electric meters, water meters, water endpoints, and related components as required. The selected vendor will also perform field deployment, integration with the City’s Oracle C2M and Oracle Meter Data Management environment, testing, commissioning, training, and go-live support needed for full AMI operations. The selected vendor will play a critical role in meeting performance, reliability, security, and interoperability requirements while advancing operational efficiency and customer service.

opportunities.source_name: OpenGov — City of Pasadena, CA
opportunities.title: Wood Pole Inspection, Treatment, Repair, and UAV Inspection Services
opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena Water and Power Department (“PWP”) is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced firms to provide wood pole inspection, repair, restoration, treatment, and related reporting services for PWP’s electric distribution system. The selected firm will support PWP’s ongoing maintenance and compliance program for wood poles, including visual inspections, intrusive inspections, groundline inspections, preservative treatments, minor corrective repairs, pole reinforcement recommendations, installation of approved repair materials, and detailed reporting of observed conditions. PWP’s wood pole program is intended to support safe, reliable, and compliant operation of the electric distribution system in accordance with applicable requirements, including California Public Utilities Commission (“CPUC”) General Order 95, Rules for Overhead Electric Line Construction, and CPUC General Order 165, Inspection Requirements for Electric Distribution and Transmission Facilities. PWP’s system includes approximately 11,000 wood poles, including both municipally owned and jointly owned poles. A significant portion of the pole population is located in rear property or otherwise constrained access locations. The scope of services may include, but is not limited to, pole condition assessment, identification of structural damage or decay, inspection for General Order 95 infractions, groundline and below-ground inspections, preservative and fumigant treatment, installation of visibility strips, guy guards, ground molding, pole tags, and steel truss reinforcement where approved by PWP. The selected firm shall also provide detailed inspection records, photographs, condition ratings, repair recommendations, and electronic data deliverables in a format acceptable to PWP. In addition to conventional field inspection and treatment services, PWP intends to include drone or other unmanned aerial vehicle (“UAV”) inspection services under the resulting contract. UAV services may be used to supplement field inspections, improve access to difficult or hazardous locations, document pole-top conditions, capture high-resolution imagery, and support more efficient assessment of pole attachments, crossarms, hardware, conductors, insulators, and other visible overhead facilities. UAV services shall be performed by qualified, FAA-compliant personnel and in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local requirements. The selected firm shall furnish all supervision, labor, materials, equipment, vehicles, tools, technology, software, transportation, permits, methods, processes, and incidentals necessary to complete the work in accordance with the final scope of services, applicable laws and regulations, industry standards, and PWP requirements.

opportunities.title: Remote Accessible Vote by Mail Ballots, Accessible Sample Ballot, UOCAVA ballots
opportunities.description: The County of San Mateo (the County or SMC) covers most of the San Francisco Peninsula. The region covers 744 mi and is home to nearly 800,000 residents and 20 incorporated cities. The County provides for the health and welfare of all people within its borders and serves as the local government for the unincorporated areas. Innovation thrives here in industries including bioscience, computer software, green technology, hospitality, financial management, health care, education and transportation. The County prides itself on how that prosperity fosters its commitment to protecting and enhancing the health, safety, welfare and natural resources of the community. The Registration & Elections Division (Division) is a division of the Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder-Elections (ACRE) in the County of San Mateo. The Division is responsible for registering all voters and conducting fair and accurate elections for cities, schools, and special districts. The Division is seeking find a vendor for three different system related to providing ballots and sample ballots and voter information guides. Remote Accessible Vote by Mail system - California Secretary of State certified system to provide Remote Accessible Vote by Mail ballots to all voters UOCAVA ballot system - Enable overseas and military voters to log in and download their ballot and ballot packet Accessible Sample Ballot system - Provide website to host the county's sample ballot and voter information guides in an WCAG accessible format County would prefer to use one vendor for all three services but is open to using different vendors.

opportunities.source_name: OpenGov — City of Pasadena, CA
opportunities.title: On-Call Parking Consultant Services
opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena Department of Transportation is soliciting proposals from qualified consulting firms to provide on-call parking consultant services across its portfolio of parking assets and programs. This includes eight City-owned parking garages, four municipal surface lots, approximately 400 multispace meters, five meter districts, parking enforcement operations and comprehensive residential, daytime, and overnight parking permit programs. Selected proposers will form an on-call bench and will be eligible to support infrastructure evaluation, operational studies, technology modernization, and strategic planning and other related activities on an as-needed basis. A minimum of three (3) years experience in such projects is required. Proposers are encouraged to focus on the areas of strength and are not required to team with a large number of sub-consultants to cover all potential types of projects. This Request for Proposals (RFP) does not solicit services for a single, defined project. Rather, the resulting consultant list will be used by the Department of Transportation to assign project-specific Task Orders for parking consulting services required for the City's Parking Division. Each Task Order will define the scope, deliverables, schedule, and coordination needs for the required work. To be considered for selection, consultants must demonstrate substantial experience preparing infrastructure evaluations, operational studies, technology modernization, and strategic planning and other related activities. Consultants selected through this RFP will be placed on an on-call bench available to support the Parking Division's needs on an as-needed basis. Placement on the on-call bench does not guarantee any minimum or maximum number of assignments.

opportunities.source_name: OpenGov — City of Pasadena, CA
opportunities.title: Rental Registry Database and Portal
opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena Rent Stabilization Department is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide a comprehensive rental registry database and online portal. The selected vendor will be responsible to meet the City's need for implementing, operating, and maintaining a system that supports the requirements of City Charter Article XVIII, which governs rent stabilization in Pasadena. The Department requires a fully hosted online platform that enables landlords to register rental units, update unit and tenancy information, apply for exemptions, and pay the City’s annual rental registry fee, including any applicable late fees. The system must also allow landlords to submit any rent registration-related notices or documents mandated by the Charter or any applicable federal, state, or local laws directly to the City through the registry portal. A Rental Registry is a core, foundational tool to monitor compliance with Charter Article XVIII to ensure that rent adjustments are in compliance with local law. There are approximately 26,000+ rental units registered within the City of Pasadena Rent Stabilization Department's Rental Registry. Rental property owners are required to register on annual basis and pay a registration fee for each rental unit. Exemptions for the annual registration fee are available and processed through the Rental Registry. Outside of the annual rental registration window from September-October, rental property owners are required to utilize the system to record key events including, but not limited to, occupancy amendments, rent increases and transfer of ownerships. The Rent Stabilization launched its Rental Registry on September 2024. It contains data for approximately 26,000+ rental units. Online payments can be made via eCheck and through Payroc via debit/credit card. A key desire for the next system is to integrate with Tyler Cashiering. City Charter Article XVIII can be accessed via this link: https://library.municode.com/ca/pasadena/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=CH_ARTXVIIIPAFAEQHOCHAM . Adopted regulations concerning rental registration, Chapter 9, are available on the Pasadena Rent Stabilization Website via this link: https://www.cityofpasadena.net/rent-stabilization/notices-forms-resources/#regulations

opportunities.source_name: OpenGov — City of Anaheim, CA
opportunities.title: Double-Sided Padmount Solid Dielectric Switchgear with Integrated Automation - Purchase Order
opportunities.description: The City of Anaheim (" Anaheim " or " City ") Public Utilities Department (" APU ") seeks proposals from interested respondents (" Respondent(s) ") to procure double-sided padmount solid-dielectric insulated switchgear with integrated automation as replacements for its 12 kV live-front, air-insulated padmounted switchgear. The dead-front and encapsulated features of the new solid-dielectric insulated switches with integrated automation are expected to improve crew safety, reliability and operational flexibility. This Request for Proposals (" RFP ") is expected to result in a proof-of-concept for additional anticipated purchases for replacing existing and installing new such switchgear at Anaheim. The selected Respondent(s) will be responsible for providing the Goods and Services described in the Scope of Work and Specifications Section and in any Attachments hereto (collectively, " Deliverables” ). After selecting a successful Respondent, the City will issue a Purchase Order, contract, or agreement form that substantially conforms to the terms and conditions outlined in this RFP, including, but not limited to, Anaheim's standard insurance and indemnity provisions appropriate for the Deliverables contemplated herein. Any resulting agreement between the City and the successful respondent will take effect upon mutual execution after Anaheim secures all necessary approvals as required under its procurement policies, rules, and the Anaheim Municipal Code .
